nonvacuity: This is an unconditional assertion about explicit probability laws, not an implication with potentially empty hypotheses. For n=k+1 the law is the pushforward of the uniform measure on all 2^n independent sign assignments, with Y_i=2*1_{i even}+epsilon_i and theta_i=n/(2*ceil(n/2)). On a common infinite independent-sign space these raw outcomes and the empty graphs are nested. E[betaHat]=1, |theta_i*Y_i-1|<=2, all degrees are zero, every weighted variance is t_n^2>0, n*Var(betaHat)=t_n^2 tends to 1, and |theta_i|<2, so every printed condition holds. scratch/Check.lean checks the small-size weight/spread conventions and a support outcome directly. Independent exact enumeration in scratch/check_witnesses.py verifies the finite decomposition, scaled variance, remainder moments, and both failure-event probabilities for all n=1..10; outputs are in scratch/witness-checks.json. The two limiting contradictions and the complete condition checklist are explained in REPORT.md.
